description: Who owns incoming stock and how it must be valued at intake. Behaviour is driven by the flags below (user-editable, no developer needed). Phase 2a uses Requires Customer and Receive at Zero Valuation; the remaining rows/flags are reserved for later phases.

fields.label: Is Active
fields.description: Inactive types cannot be used on receipts (reserved for later phases).

fields.label: Requires Customer
fields.description: Receipt lines with this type must name the Customer the goods belong to / are handled for.

fields.label: Receive at Zero Valuation
fields.description: Quantity is tracked (incl. per storage location) but stock value stays 0, so it never inflates own stock value. Line rate must be 0.

fields.label: Route to Customer Warehouse
fields.description: Route intake to the customer's own material-specific warehouse (auto-created on first use) instead of the static warehouse below.

fields.label: Requires Active BOM
fields.description: Refuse intake unless the item is a raw material in at least one active BOM. Needed when invoicing is derived from shipped finished goods (FOB per-production invoicing).

fields.label: Concept Invoice at Intake
fields.description: Create a draft Sales Invoice (Update Stock) when this material is received, and restock it at zero value once that invoice is submitted. FOB-direct: the customer buys the material on arrival.

fields.label: Route Receipts To Warehouse
fields.description: Optional. If set, receipt lines with this type must go to (or are routed to) this warehouse, e.g. a customer-stock warehouse.

name: WMS Ownership Type
